title: research: rule out rational pair gauges in the P112 rank-34 fit
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds an exact source-bound audit of every single rational two-channel basis change on the published 34-channel PR3335 P112 scalar fit. Instead of sampling a coefficient alphabet, it partitions `P1(Q)` at the finite rational slopes where source or inverse-reader coordinates vanish, then checks every distinct pair of projective directions. This covers all of `GL2(Q)`, including even denominators.

## Result

Across all 561 unordered channel pairs and 3,366 projective support cases, every pair's minimum full-plane invoice is unchanged. The global invoice remains **224**; no pair gauge improves it. A determinant-two fixture checks exact preservation of all 12,544 entries of the scalar fitting matrix and rejects a wrong inverse.

This is a scoped negative result. It closes one rational pairwise move from the published basis; it does not close sequential gauges, simultaneous blocks of size at least three, other factorizations, or a physical supplier. No kappa change is claimed.

## Validation

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-pair-gauge --check-only`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-pair-gauge`
- `python3 -B research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-pair-gauge/verify.py`
- `python3 -O -B research/paired-plane-rank34-rational-pair-gauge/verify.py`

The registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.15, including normal and optimized census runs and six focused tests.

## Task and overlap

Scientific base: canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6. The exact scope, source pins, finite-cell proof, limitations and next question are recorded in `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `CERTIFICATE.json` and `README.md`. A refreshed overlap scan covered 721 open PRs and 2,590 Discussion records at 2026-10-19 09:16 UTC. PR4004 covers finite signed-ternary 3x3 gauges; this result covers every rational 2x2 gauge on each pair, by a different complete parameterization. No novelty claim is inferred from the text search.

## Credit

Matarener/Mark and Claude via Claude Code supplied PR3335's matching and rank-34 factorization. Arham Tahir's paired-plane audit and its credited predecessors supply the full-plane tariff and 224 base invoice. Their attribution remains intact. Prepared by OpenAI Codex with substantial AI assistance; no independent human review or formal proof assistant is claimed.

## Open next questions

Can a rational simultaneous gauge on three channels or an overlapping sequence lower the tariff? First build the coupled support arrangement for one interaction-selected triple and compare against the existing signed-ternary census. Even a bill below 160 would pass only the optimistic copy screen; native dirty-state realization and supplier admission remain necessary.
